title: Computing a scaled space-constructible function
statement: Let $S:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be space constructible, and let $c\in\mathbb{N}$. Then there exist $a\in\mathbb{N}$ and a time bound $TW:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that a finite Boolean Turing machine, on every Boolean input $x$, outputs the binary representation of $cS(|x|)$ within $TW(|x|)$ steps and uses at most $aS(|x|)$ work-tape cells.
replaced:
Let $S:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be space constructible, and let $c\in\mathbb{N}$. Then
there are $a\in\mathbb{N}$ and a time bound $TW:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that a
finite Boolean Turing machine outputs the binary representation of $cS(n)$ on every
Boolean input of length $n$, within time $TW(n)$ and using at most $aS(n)$ cells of work
space.
